description:
Explain the Thai tone system with verified rules and audio examples.

    Pass a tone name in ``topic`` (mid, low, falling, high, rising) for one
    tone, or omit it for the full guide: all five tones with contour
    descriptions and examples, the complete tone-determination matrix
    (consonant class x syllable ending x tone mark), consonant class counts,
    and a same-syllable 5-tone comparison set. Use this whenever a user asks
    why a Thai word has a particular tone.
name: explain_thai_tones
